pages.text: The tubes and stations come from $(o)Tube Transport System$(), written by Alz454 (polyrobot) for 1.7.10 and carried to 1.21.1 by xy.$(br2)They behave the way they always did. What follows is where this version differs from the original, and the one setting it has.

pages.title: Speed
pages.text: $(l)MaxTubeSpeed$() caps how fast anything travels through a tube. Default $(o)0.5$(), range 0.0 to 10.0.$(br2)Raise it for long-distance networks. Push it high and you will outrun chunk loading.$(br2)It lives in $(o)config/ultimatetransport-common.toml$() now, not in the old .cfg file.

pages.title: What changed
pages.text: The undirected tube has its own greyed-out item texture, so it is not mistaken for one that points somewhere, and its tooltip says it faces the side you place it on.$(br2)No walking head bob and no footstep sounds while you ride.$(br2)Tubes and stations draw in the cutout pass, so they no longer paint over another mod's sky or clouds.

pages.title: What changed
pages.text: Two tubes of different directions meeting no longer fight over the face they share.$(br2)The 1.7.10 in-game update notifier was dropped.$(br2)The held-item ghost preview, the faint tube outline shown before you place one, was not carried over.
